mapper.select: SELECT sf.id, sf.user_id, sf.original_name, sf.object_key, sf.bucket_name, sf.content_type, sf.file_size, sf.content_hash, sf.storage_type, sf.created_at, sf.deleted, sf.deleted_at FROM sys_file sf WHERE sf.deleted = 1 AND sf.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND sf.deleted_at <= #{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_file other WHERE other.object_key = sf.object_key AND (other.deleted = 0 OR other.deleted_at IS NULL OR other.deleted_at > #{cutoff}) ) ORDER BY sf.deleted_at LIMIT #{limit}
